Structural Steel Erection Checklist 35 checkpoints across 7 sections.During and after structural steel member erection on-site; inspection of columns, beams, and connections before and after assembly; hold point before floor decking installation Download ExcelDownload PDF **35** Checkpoints **7** Sections Per erection phase (typically daily during erection, final survey upon completion) QA/QC Engineer (Steel), Structural Engineer [IS 800:2007](https://infralens.in/code/IS-800-2007) [IS 2062:2011](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2062-2011) [IS 7215:1974](https://infralens.in/code/IS-7215-1974) Related [📐IS 800](https://infralens.in/code/IS-800) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Beam & Slab Deflection Limi…](https://infralens.in/handbook/beam-deflection-limits) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. PRE-ERECTION VERIFICATION | | A1 | Foundation/anchor bolt check — position tolerance ±2mm per IS 800 Cl. 15.4
Acceptance: Measure bolt hole positions relative to grid reference lines: tolerance ±2mm x-direction, ±2mm y-direction; document actual positions; reject if >±2mm deviation | IS 800:2007 Cl. 15.4 — Foundation bolt positions | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Column base plate level survey — tolerance ±3mm per IS 800
Acceptance: Spirit level or laser level survey: base plate surface variation ≤±3mm end-to-end; if uneven, grout/shim; document survey data with 4-point measurements | IS 800:2007 Cl. 15.4 — Base plate leveling | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Grout preparation — strength and placement
Acceptance: Grout mix minimum M25 (25 MPa); thickness under base plate 40-50mm; ensure full contact between plate and grout (no voids); cure grout per spec (min 7 days before full load) | IS 800:2007 practice; foundation design standard | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Erection sequence approved by engineer
Acceptance: Written erection sequence/plan available; signed by engineer; sequence followed on-site; temporary bracing plan documented | IS 800:2007 Cl. 7 — Stability during erection | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A5 | Crane capacity adequate for heaviest member
Acceptance: Crane capacity ≥1.5× heaviest member weight; certification provided; rigger and supervisor qualified; erection insurance in place | IS 800:2007 Cl. 7 — Safe erection practice | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. MEMBER IDENTIFICATION | | B1 | All members marked per erection drawing
Acceptance: Member tag matches erection drawing mark; tag securely attached; legible; member delivered to correct location per drawing sequence | IS 800:2007 practice; traceability | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Heat number / test certificate traceable
Acceptance: MTC available before erection; heat number marked on member; MTC filed for QA records; steel grade per drawing (E250/E350/E410) | IS 2062:2011 — Material traceability | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | No damage during transport/handling
Acceptance: Visually inspect member: no dents >3mm, no cracks, no section distortion; lateral bracing intact during transport; if damaged, engineer approval required before use | IS 800:2007 practice; workmanship | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Protective coating intact — no major flaking or damage
Acceptance: Inspect 5 locations on member: coating intact (no flaking >50mm²); minor surface scratches acceptable; deep rust or flaking ≥50mm² must be repaired per spec | IS 800:2007 Cl. 11 — Protection against corrosion | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. COLUMN ERECTION | | C1 | Plumb check — tolerance 1 in 600 (max ±12mm per 7m height)
Acceptance: Measure plumb with plumb bob or laser: column vertical within 1:600 (e.g., 7m height: ±11.7mm tolerance); adjust temporary braces as needed; document measurements | IS 800:2007 Table 26 — Erection tolerances | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Alignment to grid — horizontal offset ±5mm per IS 800 Table 26
Acceptance: Measure offset from grid reference lines: x-direction ±5mm, y-direction ±5mm; if offset >5mm, adjust with shims or re-set; document offsets | IS 800:2007 Table 26 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Base plate bearing — uniform contact across bearing area
Acceptance: Check with feeler gauge/straight edge: max gap under base plate ≤1.5mm; if larger gap, add shim/grout; base plate fully seated; anchor bolts snug-tight | IS 800:2007 Cl. 15.4 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Temporary bracing secured before releasing crane
Acceptance: Temporary bracing installed and secured before crane release; bracing members rated for construction loads; torque checked; bracing remains until permanent connections completed | IS 800:2007 Cl. 7 — Safety during erection | OK
NC
NA

PRE-ERECTION VERIFICATION A1Foundation/anchor bolt check — position tolerance ±2mm per IS 800 Cl. 15.4 IS 800:2007 Cl. 15.4 — Foundation bolt positions (Anchor bolt position tolerance: ±2mm from drawing; critical for base plate fit) ✓ Measure bolt hole positions relative to grid reference lines: tolerance ±2mm x-direction, ±2mm y-direction; document actual positions; reject if >±2mm deviation OKNCNAHOLD A2Column base plate level survey — tolerance ±3mm per IS 800 IS 800:2007 Cl. 15.4 — Base plate leveling (Base plate must be level within ±3mm across bearing area) ✓ Spirit level or laser level survey: base plate surface variation ≤±3mm end-to-end; if uneven, grout/shim; document survey data with 4-point measurements OKNCNAHOLD A3Grout preparation — strength and placement IS 800:2007 practice; foundation design standard (Grout under base plate must be strong, durable, void-free) ✓ Grout mix minimum M25 (25 MPa); thickness under base plate 40-50mm; ensure full contact between plate and grout (no voids); cure grout per spec (min 7 days before full load) OKNCNAHOLD A4Erection sequence approved by engineer IS 800:2007 Cl. 7 — Stability during erection (Safe erection sequence essential; loading order must not cause instability) ✓ Written erection sequence/plan available; signed by engineer; sequence followed on-site; temporary bracing plan documented OKNCNAHOLD A5Crane capacity adequate for heaviest member IS 800:2007 Cl. 7 — Safe erection practice (Crane must have capacity ≥1.5× heaviest single member (safety factor)) ✓ Crane capacity ≥1.5× heaviest member weight; certification provided; rigger and supervisor qualified; erection insurance in place OKNCNAHOLD B. MEMBER IDENTIFICATION B1All members marked per erection drawing IS 800:2007 practice; traceability (Each member tagged with member mark (e.g., C1, B1, G1) per drawing) ✓ Member tag matches erection drawing mark; tag securely attached; legible; member delivered to correct location per drawing sequence OKNCNAHOLD B2Heat number / test certificate traceable IS 2062:2011 — Material traceability (Mill Test Certificate available; heat number matches member marking) ✓ MTC available before erection; heat number marked on member; MTC filed for QA records; steel grade per drawing (E250/E350/E410) OKNCNAHOLD B3No damage during transport/handling IS 800:2007 practice; workmanship (Members must arrive at site undamaged) ✓ Visually inspect member: no dents >3mm, no cracks, no section distortion; lateral bracing intact during transport; if damaged, engineer approval required before use OKNCNAHOLD B4Protective coating intact — no major flaking or damage IS 800:2007 Cl. 11 — Protection against corrosion (Paint/galvanize coating must be intact at delivery) ✓ Inspect 5 locations on member: coating intact (no flaking >50mm²); minor surface scratches acceptable; deep rust or flaking ≥50mm² must be repaired per spec OKNCNAHOLD C. COLUMN ERECTION C1Plumb check — tolerance 1 in 600 (max ±12mm per 7m height) IS 800:2007 Table 26 — Erection tolerances (Vertical tolerance for columns: 1 in 600 or max 12mm per 7m) ✓ Measure plumb with plumb bob or laser: column vertical within 1:600 (e.g., 7m height: ±11.7mm tolerance); adjust temporary braces as needed; document measurements OKNCNAHOLD C2Alignment to grid — horizontal offset ±5mm per IS 800 Table 26 IS 800:2007 Table 26 (Column axis alignment to structural grid within ±5mm) ✓ Measure offset from grid reference lines: x-direction ±5mm, y-direction ±5mm; if offset >5mm, adjust with shims or re-set; document offsets OKNCNAHOLD C3Base plate bearing — uniform contact across bearing area IS 800:2007 Cl. 15.4 (Base plate must have full bearing on foundation/grout; no gaps) ✓ Check with feeler gauge/straight edge: max gap under base plate ≤1.5mm; if larger gap, add shim/grout; base plate fully seated; anchor bolts snug-tight OKNCNAHOLD C4Temporary bracing secured before releasing crane IS 800:2007 Cl. 7 — Safety during erection (Members unstable until connections made; temporary bracing essential) ✓ Temporary bracing installed and secured before crane release; bracing members rated for construction loads; torque checked; bracing remains until permanent connections completed OKNCNAHOLD Showing 13 of 35 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED — Steel frame erected per specification; ready for next phase (decking/cladding) APPROVED WITH NCR — Minor deviations documented; acceptable per engineer; NCR filed REJECTED — Major non-conformances; re-erection or re-alignment required; member may need replacement Overall Verdict Name / Sign / Date Number of NC Items Name / Sign / Date Members Approved for Next Phase Name / Sign / Date NCR Number (if applicable) Name / Sign / Date Inspector Signature Name / Sign / Date Date & Time Name / Sign / Date Structural Engineer Sign-off Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
